terra.problem: Calls the baker's choice 'wrong,' which Papa Dorin must not do.
1 Samuel 17:50 does not establish that Goliath had a sword. Verse 51 does.
The one-hand joke doesn't fit the answer: seven of each would be fourteen animals.
'That would be quite the show' makes a spectacle of the ark, a holy object.
The wings overshadow the ark, but the text does not say whether they point toward the temple doors.
The statement that God provided manna for Israel in the wilderness needs a reference outside this passage.
The claim about Aaron's role in Israel's worship needs a supporting reference; Exodus 4:14 establishes that he was Moses' brother.
'Joshua was close by in those days' implies a connection to the placement of the tablets that the cited verse does not establish.
The text does not state that the glory is the reason for the cloud, or what anyone was thinking about.
'Couldn't stay standing' changes the text. The priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud.
The short-term rental joke makes the LORD's dwelling the subject of the humor rather than keeping the comparison on the human side.
The passage does not say that the elders were gathered first.
'God chose a person instead of a city' adds a substitution the text does not state.
'That's the next card' refers to the lesson's mechanics, which Papa Dorin does not discuss.
The cited verse says Saul was made king, but does not establish that he was Israel's first king.
The passage does not say that the covenant was made somewhere other than a king's court.
